player_prompt.intro:
A yɛ Player {player_id} nɛ HighSociety (ko'bur nɛ fla wɛlɛ).
Wɛlɛ tɛmɛ:  Kadi pɛrɛ pɛrɛ kɛɛrɛ wɛlɛ fla ka tɛmɛ.
La'bo':    Kɛɛrɛ kɛɛrɛ, la'bo' kadi koom 1-11 ka tɛmɛ.
            • La'bo' ka tɛmɛ wɛlɛ fla wɛlɛ kadi pɛrɛ ka tɛmɛ.
            • La'bo' ka tɛmɛ wɛlɛ fla tɛmɛ kadi koom.
            • A yɛrɛ -> la'bo' ka tɛmɛ fla wɛlɛ ka tɛmɛ.
Ko'bur:    Kɛɛrɛ fla wɛlɛ, tɛmɛ **koom ka tɛmɛ + pɛrɛ ka tɛmɛ**.
            Ko'bur ka tɛmɛ wɛlɛ fla wɛlɛ (a yɛrɛ -> a yɛrɛ).

**Tɛmɛ tɛmɛ**  →  la'bo' kadi koom ka tɛmɛ '[7]' wɛlɛ '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ko'bur ku wa ka tɛmɛ kadi [X] koom.
invalid_move.card_not_held: A fɔ ka tɛmɛ kadi koom.

message.tie: A yɛrɛ - yɛrɛ la'bo' ka tɛmɛ. La'bo'!
